title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Premium Uplift by Cargo Category
content:
Under `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims`, the handling category of the covered goods can raise the premium.

## Definition

The **gross premium** is the base premium increased by the uplift percentage that the tier sets for the goods category the cover records. The uplift acts on the base premium.

| Goods category on the cover | Uplift applied |
|---|---|
| dangerous goods | the tier's dangerous goods uplift |
| reefer | the tier's reefer uplift |
| out of gauge | the tier's out-of-gauge uplift |
| general | none |

The gross premium is not rounded.

## Worked examples (hypothetical uplifts)

- A base premium of 300.00 for out-of-gauge goods, with a hypothetical out-of-gauge uplift of 12 percent, gives a gross premium of 336.00.
- A base premium of 300.00 for general goods gives a gross premium of 300.00, whatever uplifts the tier sets for other categories.
- A base premium of 180.00 for refrigerated goods, with a hypothetical reefer uplift of 5 percent, gives 189.00.
